questions.question: Which part of the JDK turns your .java source files into bytecode?
questions.explanation: javac compiles source code into bytecode; the JVM then runs that bytecode.

questions.question: What is the oldest Java version that Spring Boot 4 can run on?
questions.explanation: Spring Boot 4 needs Java 17 or newer; this course uses Java 21.

questions.question: The JavaCheck program from this topic checks Runtime.version().feature() >= 17. What does it print when run with Java 11?
options: Only the line: Ready for Spring Boot 4
A compile error, because Java 11 cannot run single-file programs
Java version: 11... followed by Too old: install Java 17+
questions.explanation: Java 11 can run a single source file, prints its version, and 11 is below 17, so the else branch runs.

questions.question: On Windows, JAVA_HOME is set to C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-21\bin and mvnw fails to find Java. What is the fix?
options: Point JAVA_HOME at the jdk-21 folder, not its bin folder
Delete the bin folder from the JDK
questions.explanation: JAVA_HOME must name the JDK root folder; tools add \bin themselves.

questions.question: Why can you build an Initializr project without installing Maven yourself?
options: Spring Boot does not use a build tool
The IDE compiles everything without Maven
The project includes the Maven Wrapper (mvnw), which downloads a fixed Maven version on first use
Maven is built into the JDK
questions.explanation: mvnw downloads and runs the Maven version the project asks for, so everyone builds the same way.
